sections.advice: This Straupitz windmill sight → Schwielochsee water stop stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.advice: Schwielochsee water stop → Back to Lübbenau is the reward section in Berlin. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

scenicChapters.narrative: 48 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Straupitz windmill sight → Schwielochsee water stop
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 53 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

places-segment-inka-hamash-ayash-chavin-.story: 89 km from Puños to Puños, about 1 h 32 of riding. On the way it passes Segment Taulli - Tambillo, Chavin and back through Segment Taulli - Tambillo. The highest point is about 4,400 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
